blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines–Filipino EYEKONS are getting another chance to see KATSEYE live as the global girl group adds a second Manila show to its upcoming THE WILDWORLD TOUR. In an announcement on Thursday, November 19, Live Nation Philippines confirmed that an additional concert will be held on Jan. 30, 2027, at the SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City. The new date comes after tickets to the group’s initial Manila concert on Jan. 29 were sold out, prompting the addition of another show for Filipino fans.
